UNIVERSITY INSTITUTE OF PHARMACEUTICAL SCIENCES, SECTOR 14,
PANJAB UNIVERSITY, CHANDIGARH 160014
Corrigendum
This is with referene to filling of one post of of SRF in the research project entitled “A fluorescent
cyclic peptide conjugated amphipathic-D diastereomers nanotherapeutics for an early
detection and treatment of prostate cancer” by DST-SERB CRG, Government of India
(CRG/2022/000628) granted to Dr. Gurpal Singh (UIPS, PU), Dr Ravi Pratap Barnwal (Department of
Biophysics, PU), Prof Sanjay Kumar Bhadada (PGIMER, Chandigarh) and Prof Rakesh Kapoor
(PGIMER, Chandigarh) to be executed in the University Institute of Pharmaceutical Scieicnes, Panjab
University Chandigarh.
Candidates kindly note that:
The late date to apply for this post has been extended until 25 November 2023 either by post or
email at gurpalsingh.ips@gmail.com
Yours sincerely
Gurpal Singh, Ph.D.
UIPS, Panjab University, Chandigarh
